claims.claim: One of the best book for psychiatry
claims.evidence: Witness only reports the book cover text (PSYCHOLOGY, Seventh Edition, Shorter Oxford Textbook of Psychology). No content/quality evidence.

claims.claim: Original copies, not photocopies or local reprints.
claims.evidence: No ISBN/printing details, publisher page, or authenticity markers are readable in the provided witness report.
Witness report does not include photos of inside pages or any writing/highlighting.

risks.risk: Condition may be poor (heavy cover wear, spine damage, page tears) which affects resale value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the spine and the front/back covers showing wear, plus a close-up of the page edges for tears/loose pages.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used book with unknown condition (worst-case: noticeable wear/possible damage).

risks.risk: Completeness is unknown (missing pages or missing accompanying materials).
risks.proof: A photo showing the table of contents and a quick flip-through clip showing multiple pages in sequence (including early and late sections).

risks.risk: Authenticity is unknown (could be a reprint/photocopy).
risks.proof: A photo of the copyright/printing page with ISBN and publisher details (and/or barcode) clearly readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed original (worst-case: reprint/photocopy risk).

risks.risk: Inside may have writing/highlighting or annotations.
risks.proof: A clear photo of several interior pages (beginning, middle, and end) showing whether there is highlighting/notes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if writing/highlighting may be present.

risks.risk: Format/size (paperback vs hardback) and edition specifics may differ, affecting price.
risks.proof: A photo of the title/copyright page showing format details and edition/printing information.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest value among common formats for that edition.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the spine and both front/back covers (showing wear).
Send a photo of the copyright/printing page with ISBN and publisher details readable.
Send 3–5 clear interior page photos (beginning, middle, end) to confirm no writing/highlighting.
Send a short clip flipping through pages to confirm completeness (no missing pages).
Confirm whether it is paperback or hardback with a photo of the title/copyright page.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the book as “Shorter Oxford Textbook of Psychology (Seventh Edition)” from the cover, so it can be priced at worst-case used condition. Seller claims about originality and no writing are not verifiable from the provided report, so pricing should assume the worst until proof is shown.
